# ARC Report

> ARC Report is the public reference dataset for AI agent access in e-commerce. It scans 1,000+ e-commerce brands every day — robots.txt policy per agent, live HTTP tests with 9 AI agent user-agents, structured data, platform/CDN/WAF detection, and protocol files (llms.txt, agents.txt, UCP) — and publishes everything as open data (CC BY 4.0).

Canonical host: https://www.arcreport.ai (the apex redirects here).

## Arc for Agencies

ARC Report is also a paid AI-commerce monitoring workspace for ecommerce agencies. Agencies can monitor up to 50 client or prospect stores, prioritize access and product-data issues, generate co-branded reports, receive regression alerts, and query private portfolio intelligence through an authenticated MCP server.

- [Agency product](https://www.arcreport.ai/#agency-system): product overview and pricing.
- [Agency sign-in and self-serve workspace](https://www.arcreport.ai/agency/login): passwordless agency access.
- [Agency MCP documentation](https://www.arcreport.ai/docs/agency-mcp): private, workspace-scoped portfolio tools.

## Data downloads (CC BY 4.0)

- [Latest snapshot, JSON](https://www.arcreport.ai/data/latest.json): Full daily snapshot — every brand's per-agent access, signals, and ARC Score with component breakdown.
- [Latest snapshot, CSV](https://www.arcreport.ai/data/latest.csv): Same data, one row per brand.
- [Dated archive](https://www.arcreport.ai/data): /data/YYYY-MM-DD.json or .csv for historical snapshots.
- Attribution required: "Data: ARC Report (www.arcreport.ai), licensed CC BY 4.0".

## API (no auth, per-IP rate limits)

- [API documentation](https://www.arcreport.ai/docs): All read endpoints with curl examples.
- [Agent access matrix](https://www.arcreport.ai/api/matrix): JSON — every brand × 9 agents.
- [Changelog](https://www.arcreport.ai/api/changelog): JSON — confirmed changes, newest first.
- [Scan health](https://www.arcreport.ai/api/scan-health): JSON — pipeline status and data freshness.

## MCP server

- Endpoint: https://www.arcreport.ai/api/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no auth).
- Tools: get_brand_status, search_brands, get_recent_changes, get_agent_stats, compare_brands.
- [Public dataset MCP](https://www.arcreport.ai/docs/mcp): no-auth access to the public brand index.
- [Agency MCP](https://www.arcreport.ai/docs/agency-mcp): authenticated private portfolio tools for paid agency workspaces.

## Markdown variants (for language models)

Append `.md` to key pages for clean text/markdown:

- [Matrix](https://www.arcreport.ai/matrix.md): Full brand × agent access table with ARC Scores.
- [Insights](https://www.arcreport.ai/insights.md): Headline stats — blocking rates per agent, category openness, platform breakdown.
- [Leaderboard](https://www.arcreport.ai/leaderboard.md): Most-open and most-restricted brands by ARC Score.
- [Changelog](https://www.arcreport.ai/changelog.md): Recent confirmed changes.
- [Methodology](https://www.arcreport.ai/methodology.md): How scans work, two-scan confirmation rule, ARC Score v1.0 formula, limitations.
- Per-brand: https://www.arcreport.ai/brand/<slug>.md (e.g. /brand/nike.md).

## Key pages

- [Home / brand index](https://www.arcreport.ai/): Full server-rendered index of all tracked brands.
- [Agent access matrix](https://www.arcreport.ai/matrix): Brand × agent heatmap.
- [Insights](https://www.arcreport.ai/insights): Auto-computed headline statistics with citation anchors.
- [Changelog](https://www.arcreport.ai/changelog): Daily confirmed changes (RSS: /changelog.xml).
- [Weekly digest](https://www.arcreport.ai/weekly): What moved each week, archived.
- [Methodology](https://www.arcreport.ai/methodology): Scan design, confirmation rules, score formula.
- [Reliability](https://www.arcreport.ai/reliability): Scan success rates, corrections log, dispute process.
- [About](https://www.arcreport.ai/about): Who builds this and why.

## Citing this data

Cite a statistic as: "<stat> — ARC Report, <date>, arcreport.ai/insights#<anchor>". Each stat on /insights has an anchor link and a copy-citation button. Per-agent status values are: allowed, no_rule (open by default), blocked (robots.txt policy), restricted (WAF/CDN), inconclusive.
